label: DrayTek Vigor167 VDSL2 35b supervectoring modem
description: VDSL2 profile 35b supervectoring modem/router rated at 300 Mbit/s downlink, backward compatible with ADSL2+ at 20 Mbit/s, with one RJ-11 line port and two gigabit Ethernet LAN ports behind an SPI firewall.
notes: Datasheet: 1 x VDSL2 35b/ADSL2+ RJ-11, 2 x GbE RJ-45, 'Max. VDSL Speed 300 Mbps', 'Max. ADSL Speed 20 Mbps', VDSL2 profiles 8a/8b/8c/8d/12a/12b/17a/30a/35b. 35b maps to the engine's 300M DSL rung - the two LAN ports are gigabit, the line is not.
